The Fieldkit TypeScript SDK covers everything the dashboard does. It has no runtime dependencies and runs anywhere `fetch` does.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @fieldkit/sdk
```

## Getting Started

```typescript
import { Fieldkit } from '@fieldkit/sdk'

const fk = new Fieldkit({ apiKey: process.env.FIELDKIT_API_KEY })
const devices = await fk.devices.list({ labels: { team: 'north' } })
```

:::caution
Do not ship an API key to a browser. In a browser, pass `keyProvider` and fetch a short-lived key from your own backend.
:::

## Reference

Every method returns a Promise. Lists are async iterables that page transparently.
